lines.ro: Website, app, or software?
Most business owners pay for the wrong one.
They sound the same. They do completely different jobs.
Think of a coffee shop.
One. Your website is the storefront. People find you, check the menu, and walk in.
Two. An app is the loyalty card in their pocket. It brings them back, again and again.
Three. Software is the back office. Inventory, staff, payroll. Everything customers never see.
Storefront first. Loyalty card later. Back office when it starts to hurt.
Which one do you need right now? Comment storefront, card, or back office.
Not sure? DM us. The first call is free.
